sources.reason: spec-complete: official Webflow OpenAPI 3.1.0 (github.com/webflow/openapi-spec, openapi/v2.yml, pushed 2026-05-26) covers 117 operations across all 16 documented Data API tags. Docs at developers.webflow.com are Fern-generated from this same spec. No competitor, community tool, or doc page references additional Data API HTTP surface. The official MCP server's extra tools (deElement/dePages/deStyle/deVariable) run over the Webflow Designer app bridge, not replayable HTTP, and are out of scope for a printed CLI by the Phase 1.7 replayability rule.
